name: SKF
summary: SKF documents separate wireless and wired vibration-monitoring routes into @ptitude Observer; @ptitude Analyst remains a parallel periodic-data product. Baker Instruments is now Megger-owned.

flows.name: Enlight Collect IMx-1 wireless monitoring

steps.label: IMx-1 sensor
steps.detail: Battery sensor measures vibration and temperature, including acceleration enveloping.

steps.label: Mesh and gateway
steps.detail: Low-energy mesh carries readings to a gateway; Ethernet, Wi-Fi or mobile backhaul can connect to the host.

steps.label: @ptitude Observer
steps.detail: The documented host software trends, visualizes and analyzes the measurements.

steps.label: SKF monitoring
steps.detail: Site users or SKF monitoring services review the machine information and diagnostics.

flows.caveat: SKF also promotes Enlight AI and Enlight Centre, but the public pages do not establish a mandatory IMx-1-to-Aptitude Insight route.

flows.name: Wired IMx monitoring

steps.label: IMx-8 / IMx-16
steps.detail: Hardwired online modules collect vibration and other machinery-condition signals.

steps.label: Online module
steps.detail: Continuous acquisition at the equipment feeds the monitoring software; deployment wiring varies by site.

steps.label: @ptitude Observer
steps.detail: Observer manages and analyzes online measurements.

steps.label: Condition review
steps.detail: Users review trends, diagnostics and exceptions in the software.

flows.caveat: IMx-M is a separate protection system with shutdown outputs; it should not be drawn as the normal endpoint of these diagnostic flows.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §2: IMx-1 mesh sensors and @ptitude Observer.
findings.assessment: SKF's own system description explicitly links IMx-1 sensors, mesh gateway and @ptitude Observer host software.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §2: Baker Instrument line listed as an SKF product.
findings.assessment: Megger acquired Baker Instruments from SKF in October 2018. Baker is historical SKF context, not a current SKF product line.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §2: @ptitude Observer → Aptitude Insight is implied as one software chain.
findings.assessment: SKF identifies Observer and Analyst as members of the @ptitude suite and describes them as parallel developments. The cited current SKF sources do not establish an Observer-to-'Aptitude Insight' succession or required hop.

findings.archived_claim: vendor-product-catalogue.md §1: IMx-M as an API 670 protection rack distinct from IMx-8/16 monitoring.
findings.assessment: SKF describes IMx-M as a machinery shutdown/protection system with API 670 compliance, and IMx-8/16 as online monitoring modules.

unknowns: The current official SKF pages reviewed do not verify 'Aptitude Insight' as a named successor to @ptitude Observer or its deployment modes.
Internal hosting, databases and model implementations behind SKF cloud services are not publicly mapped by these sources.
